items.label: Read the shock off her skin
Pressed the right loin — the source's address
Urine tested — the source named on a strip
Thirty mils a kilo through real bore
The lines never ran dry into the shock
The enemy got named — cultures flew first
The golden hour never closed empty
Noradrenaline when the volume stopped answering
Vasoplegia never left to sag unanswered
Source control — a door for the pus
Named it — septic shock, with its source
